name: High cloud coming
story: Still fine, but the sky is changing: a halo round the sun by noon, a thin veil thickening from the southwest by evening, the wind backing southeast. The front is two days out and the radio says so.
forecast: Fine, high cloud thickening from the southwest in the afternoon. Wind backing southeast 6-10 kt. Pressure falling slowly. Night: high overcast, the moon a pale disc. A FRONT is forecast for the day after tomorrow.
